THE MELON BARGE, THE CAGE MAST AND THE ROPE COILS: nearest and biggest a broad flat barge riding so low under a mountain of striped green-and-gold melons that its gunwale kisses the waterline, a small sprite figure side-on poling at its stern; turned broadside beyond it a slim punt with birdcages stacked so high they form its entire silhouette, a wooden bird on a pole at the prow; and small and well to the side a dye boat trailing coils of rope in eight colours over its stern into flat pixel bands of water.

THE CHILLI ROOF, THE FLOWER CLOUD AND THE SEED HEAP: a squat wide boat roofed entirely in scarlet drying chillies nearest and painted in the most detail, its whole top half a burning red fringe, a small sprite figure seen from behind threading another string of peppers; overlapping behind it a flower punt so heaped in coral and white blooms that the blossoms double the hull's outline completely; and tiny at the far left a seed-and-grain boat with rough sacks of coarse undyed jute with their necks tied in bright dyed cord stacked in a blocky odd-numbered heap, the topmost sack lopsided and about to slide.

THE STEAM HATCH, THE LANTERN GLOW AND THE STACKED BASKETS: nearest a narrow noodle boat with a little orange-tiled roof and steam pouring straight up out of a hatch, three small stools along its rail and a sprite figure side-on ladling into a bowl held by a tiny figure at mid-distance; further out and broadside a lantern-seller's boat glowing from inside like a paper lamp, paper lanterns strung the full length of its bamboo mast; and well off to the right a boat stacked head-high in bamboo steamers, its silhouette a stepped stack of nested circles.

THE JAR BOAT, THE HERB CURTAIN AND THE TINY FERRY: a wide pottery boat nearest, blue-glazed jars nested in straw rising to the gunwales, a small sprite figure side-on lifting one jar with both arms; behind and overlapping it a herb boat so draped in hanging bundles of dried stems that the bundles hide its cabin entirely, only its prow and stern visible; and small at the far edge a one-person ferry with a single seated sprite passenger, its wake fanning in flat pixel bands.

THE LACQUER STACK, THE DRYING FISH FAN AND THE KITE CLOUD: biggest and nearest a low dark hull carrying lacquered red bowls stacked two dozen deep in an uneven stack and each one small, a small sprite figure bracing the topmost bowl with one hand; turned at an angle beyond it a fish boat under a fan of silver drying fish on lines strung bow to stern, scales catching flat bands of light; and a slim punt well to the right with three kites on short strings riding above it, their tails trailing down past the sail.

THE LOTUS PUNT, THE COPPER KETTLE AND THE BIRDCAGE STACK: nearest a long punt almost invisible under a carpet of flat lotus pads and tall pink blooms, only its stern and pole visible, a small sprite figure seen from behind; broadside beyond it a tea boat with a copper kettle on a brazier glowing amber, three mismatched stools along the rail and a sprite figure passing a cup to a tiny distant figure; and off to one side a tall narrow boat whose stacked birdcages form a single stack taller than its mast.

THE ROPE RAINBOW, THE PEPPER CURTAIN AND THE LOW MELON HULL: a dye boat nearest and biggest, coils of rope in nine saturated colours piled and draped over every surface, two coils hanging in the water and bleeding flat colour bands into the reflection; behind it and overlapping a chilli boat with a curtain of dried red peppers hanging from a bamboo rail the full length of its deck; and a small melon barge at the far right riding so low its gunwale is a single pixel above the waterline.

THE CANDLE PLANK, THE GLASS SWEETS BOX AND THE STRAW JARS: nearest a long flat boat with a plank running hull to hull holding seven small candles in flat clay dishes, a sprite figure seen from behind trimming a wick; turned broadside further out a sweets boat with a little glass-fronted box of coloured sugar blocks on a folding shelf, its hull plain ochre; and small at the far left a pottery boat, jars nested in straw in odd-numbered clusters, the largest jar cracked and wrapped in a strip of orange cloth.

THE BAMBOO STEAMER WALL, THE FLOWER SILHOUETTE AND THE GRAIN SACKS: a bamboo-basket boat nearest and broadside, steamers stacked so wide they overhang both rails, a small sprite figure side-on sliding one basket from the stack with a pole; a flower punt beyond it, its blooms in yellow and violet so thick the hull beneath is a guess, one small figure seen from behind with an armful of stems; and a seed boat well to the side with rough sacks of coarse undyed jute with their necks tied in bright dyed cord in an uneven stepped pile, the smallest sack perched sideways on top.

THE HERB BOAT, THE LACQUER STACK AND THE PAPER LANTERN GLOW: nearest a wide herb boat hung so densely in dried bundles that only its hull's flat green sides show below the hanging curtain, a sprite figure seen from behind reaching into the bundles; further out and at an angle a lacquer boat with red and black bowls in stacks of five, the tallest stack leaning; and small and far to the right a lantern boat so full of glowing paper lanterns that its hull seems to float in its own warm flat pixel light.

THE FISH FAN, THE MELON MOUNTAIN AND THE CAGE STACK: biggest and nearest a fish boat under a full fan of silver drying fish on lines, a small sprite figure side-on unhooking one fish from a lower line; turned broadside behind it a melon barge so heaped with fruit that the mountain rises above the cabin, the hull riding deep with chunky stepped waterline bands; and well off to the side a slim boat whose stacked wicker cages form a stack that sways, the top cage hanging at an angle from a rope.

THE STEAM BOAT, THE CHILLI FRINGE AND THE ROPE COILS: nearest a noodle boat with a low striped orange awning and steam rising from two hatches at once, three bowls lined along the rail, a sprite figure side-on at the brazier; overlapping behind it a chilli boat roofed in a fringe of scarlet peppers that hang down past the windows, its hull plain yellow; and a rope boat small at the far edge, coils in five colours looped on pegs along its rail, two coils trailing in the water.

THE LOTUS PILE, THE COPPER GLOW AND THE TINY KITE PUNT: nearest a broad punt heaped with cut lotus stems and open blooms in pink and white, stems overhanging the bow and trailing in the water, a small sprite figure seen from behind arranging a bundle; broadside further out a tea boat with a copper kettle so large it takes up the stern, its sides lit amber in flat pixel bands, a sprite figure passing something small across the rail; and tiny at the far right a kite punt with four kites on short strings pulling at different angles above it.

THE SWEETS BOAT, THE STRAW JARS AND THE HERB CURTAIN: nearest a sweets boat with a little glass-fronted cabinet of coloured blocks on a shelf, an awning in faded blue cloth stretched on bamboo poles, a small sprite figure side-on lifting the cabinet lid; behind it a pottery boat with glazed yellow jars packed in straw in three uneven rows; and small and broadside at the far left a herb boat whose hanging bundles are so thick they form a solid curtain of grey-green.

THE LACQUER STACK, THE LOW BARGE AND THE CANDLE ROW: biggest and nearest a lacquer boat with bowls in red and black stacked in an uneven stack, a small sprite figure bracing the stack with one hand and passing a bowl with the other; behind and overlapping it a melon barge so loaded it rides at the waterline; and small and turned at an angle to the right a candle boat with nine small candles in clay dishes along a plank, each flame a single bright pixel.

THE BAMBOO STACK, THE FLOWER CLOUD AND THE ROPE RAINBOW: a bamboo-steamer boat nearest and biggest, its baskets stacked so high they form an off-centre stepped stack, a small sprite figure side-on at the top of a short ladder; a flower punt beyond it almost invisible under coral, white and violet blooms doubling its outline; and well to the left a dye boat trailing long coils of rope in seven saturated colours, the coils hanging in flat stepped bands over the stern into the water.

THE GRAIN HEAP, THE LANTERN MAST AND THE PEPPER ROOF: nearest a seed boat with odd sacks of coarse undyed jute with their necks tied in bright dyed cord stacked in a blocky heap two dozen small sacks deep, the topmost sack slumped sideways, a small sprite figure seen from behind lifting another sack; a lantern-seller's boat beyond it broadside, paper lanterns strung from its bamboo mast to its bow so the whole boat seems to glow from inside; and small at the far right a chilli boat roofed in scarlet peppers, a sprite figure tiny at its stern.

THE FISH LINES, THE KITE CLOUD AND THE TINY FERRY: a fish boat nearest and biggest with silver drying fish on lines strung at five different heights, their flat scales catching the light, a small sprite figure side-on working a lower line; turned at an angle behind it a kite punt with three kites in different shapes on short strings tugging upward; and tiny at the far left a one-person ferry with a single seated sprite figure, its wake a fan of flat pixel bands.

THE JAR BOAT, THE STEAM ROOF AND THE CAGE SILHOUETTE: nearest a wide pottery boat with jars in two sizes nested in straw, their glazed blue sides reflecting in chunky flat pixel bands, a sprite figure side-on checking the straw packing; overlapping behind it a noodle boat with a striped red canopy and steam rising from its hatch in a stack that drifts sideways; and small and broadside to the right a birdcage boat so stacked with cages its outline is pure geometry, a wooden bird on a pole above them.

THE LOTUS CURTAIN, THE LACQUER STACK AND THE LOW MELON HULL: a lotus boat nearest, its stems bundled upright along the rail so they form a curtain of pale green and pink, a small sprite figure seen from behind binding another bundle with a strip of cloth; behind it and at an angle a lacquer boat with red bowls in stacks of four, one stack leaning and a sprite figure side-on steadying it with a palm; and a melon barge small at the far right, its gunwale barely above the waterline.

THE HERB CURTAIN, THE CANDLE BOAT AND THE GRAIN SACKS: nearest and biggest a herb boat so draped in hanging dried bundles that the bundles form its entire upper silhouette, only the flat painted hull below them visible, a small sprite figure seen from behind parting two bundles; turned broadside behind it a candle boat with eleven small flames along a plank, the flames in a slightly uneven line, one higher than the rest; and small at the far left a seed boat with sacks of coarse undyed jute with their necks tied in bright dyed cord in a rough stepped pile, one split sack leaking grain.

THE ROPE BOAT, THE BAMBOO STACK AND THE SWEETS CABINET: a dye boat nearest and biggest, rope coils in eight colours looped along every rail and two coils hanging overboard leaving colour trails in the water, a sprite figure side-on lifting a coil; a bamboo-steamer boat behind it with baskets stacked in a stepped stack wider at the base, the top basket askew; and small and well to the right a sweets boat with its glass-fronted cabinet of coloured blocks, hull plain red with a painted flat flower on its side.

THE LANTERN BOAT, THE FLOWER SILHOUETTE AND THE TINY PEPPER PUNT: a lantern-seller's boat nearest and biggest, paper lanterns of four different shapes hung from mast to bow rail, the boat glowing with warm flat pixel light from inside, a sprite figure seen from behind hanging one more lantern; a flower punt behind it so loaded with blooms in orange and cream that its hull outline is entirely doubled by petals; and tiny at the far right a small chilli punt with a fringe of scarlet peppers hanging from a single bamboo rail.

THE FISH BOAT, THE JAR STACK AND THE STEAM HATCH: nearest and biggest a fish boat under a fan of silver drying fish on five lines strung at different heights, a sprite figure side-on reaching up to the highest line; behind it and overlapping a pottery boat with tall narrow glazed jars in two mismatched stacks, the taller stack tied with a strip of orange cloth; and small and broadside to the left a noodle boat with steam pouring out of a single hatch, a sprite figure tiny at the stern.

THE MELON BARGE, THE KITE PUNT AND THE LACQUER BOWLS: biggest and nearest a melon barge riding so low its gunwale is a hard pixel step above the waterline, green-and-yellow melons piled into a rounded mountain, a small sprite figure side-on at its stern with a pole; turned at an angle behind it a kite punt with five kites on short strings in five colours pulling at different angles above the hull; and small and well to the right a lacquer boat with red and black bowls in stacks of three, the smallest stack set apart at the prow.
